introduce: Stand or sit on the floor. Raise your shoulders up towards your ears as far as you can, then drop them. Repeat the exercise.
name: SHOULDER SHRUGS

tips.text: Raise your shoulders up as high as you can.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale as you raise your shoulders, and inhale as you drop them.
This exercise can loosen up your neck and upper back.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath in and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, round your spine toward the ceiling and draw your navel up towards your spine, and drop your head.

Repeat the exercise, matching the movement to your breath.
name: CAT COW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale slowly to lift your right leg and use your left hand to pull your right knee to the left. Extend your right arm to the side, palm down.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds. With each exhale, soften and deepen the twist.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist and relax.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale slowly to lift your left leg and use your right hand to pull your left knee to the right. Extend your left arm to the side, palm down.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds. With each exhale, soften and deepen the twist.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist and relax.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your left knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your left knee towards your chest, keeping your right leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your right knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your right knee towards your chest, keeping your left leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce: Bring your chin down to your chest, and hold it for a few seconds. \n\nThen look up towards the ceiling, and also hold it for a few seconds. Repeat the exercise.
name: UP & DOWN NODS

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please don't turn your head.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Turn your head to the left, and hold it for a few seconds. \n\nThen turn your head to the right, and also hold it for a few seconds. Repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE-TO-SIDE TURNS

tips.text: Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Tilt your head towards your left shoulder, and hold it for a few seconds. \n\nThen tilt your head towards your right shoulder, and also hold it for a few seconds. Repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE-TO-SIDE TILTS

tips.text: Please don't move your shoulders when tilting your head.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Stand or sit with your arms at your sides. Roll your shoulders up towards your ears, then roll them back and squeeze, then roll them down. Repeat the exercise.
name: CLOCKWISE SHOULDER ROLLS

tips.text: Please just move your shoulders, and keep your neck relaxed.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Lie down on your back with your legs extended. Relax your spine and gently press your lower back into the floor. 

Inhale, lift your knees toward your chest. Exhale, hug your knees gently.

Hold the position without holding your breath. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. Exhale as you soften your shoulders and hips.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your right knee, and grab the back of your right thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your right ankle on your left knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your left knee, and grab the back of your left thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your right leg in and extend your left leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your left foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your left hamstring.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your left thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your left leg in and extend your right leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your right foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your right hamstring.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your right thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.

introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

Inhale, bring your left knee forward, and place your left knee behind your left wrist on the ground. Exhale, slide your right leg back, extending it straight behind you.

Put your forearms on the ground in front of your leg. 

Hold for a few seconds. Inhale to lengthen your spine forward. Exhale, release tension in your left hip.
name: PIGEON POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Your front knee should be in line with the outside of your shoulder.
You should not feel any discomfort.
This exercise helps to make your muscle groups more flexible.
This exercise helps to reduce sciatic pain.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to soften your left hip to open.

introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

Inhale, bring your right knee forward, and place your right knee behind your right wrist on the ground. Exhale, slide your left leg back, extending it straight behind you.

Put your forearms on the ground in front of your leg. 

Hold for a few seconds. Inhale to lengthen your spine forward. Exhale, release tension in your right hip.
name: PIGEON POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Your front knee should be in line with the outside of your shoulder.
You should not feel any discomfort.
This exercise helps to make your muscle groups more flexible.
This exercise helps to reduce sciatic pain.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to soften your right hip to open.

introduce: Lie flat on your back with legs extended wider than hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides, palms up. \n\nInhale slowly through your nose, your spine gently lengthening and your body becoming light. Exhale fully, allowing your shoulders, hips, and entire body to melt into the mat, and consciously relax any areas of tightness or tension throughout your body.
name: RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Close your eyes, relax your arms and legs, relax your face, relax the ankles.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to release tension of your body.
Let any weight, any tension relax to the earth, feel the floor below you, supporting you.
Let every part of your body relax and lower to the ground.
Invite rest and peace into your mind, body and soul.

introduce:
Sit with the soles of your feet together. Draw your heels towards your hips, and gently press your knees down.

Exhale, hinge forward from your hips, reaching your hands toward the floor. 

Hold this position. Inhale to lift and extend through your spine, exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
name: EASY BUTTERFLY POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Press your knees down as much as possible.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
Keep your sit bones down.
You should feel the stretch in your thighs.
This position can open up your hips and thighs.
This position helps stretch your thighs.

introduce: Start on all fours. Exhale as you lift your hips into an inverted ‘V’ shape, and lengthen your spine.\n\nAlternately lift and lower your heels with steady breath.
name: WALK THE DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Relax your neck.
Keep a steady and even breathing rhythm without holding your breath.
Notice the elongation from your fingertips to your sit bone.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Please press all areas of the palms equally on the floor.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, hamstrings, calves, and arches.

introduce:
Lie down on your stomach and bend your elbows with your hands beneath your shoulders.

Keep your toes back and your feet and legs relaxed on the ground.

Exhale, push your chest up off the ground as far as possible. As you inhale, return to the start position and repeat.
name: COBRAS

tips.text: Prepare a mat first.
Tighten your abdominals.
Stretch your abdominals as much as you can.
Inhale when you go up, and exhale when you go down.
This is a great exercise to strengthen your back.
